name: @rayu-dev/web-bridge-client
description: The rayu-cli side of the rayu-backend Web Bridge: protocol mirror plus the socket.io client both workers (the rayu CLI REPL and the rayucode extension host) use to be remote-controlled from the rayu-web studio. Depends on nothing in this repository.
//dependencies: socket.io-client is pinned to the EXACT version rayu-backend and rayu-web use (both 4.8.3). socket.io negotiates a protocol between client and server, and a mismatched major silently fails the handshake rather than erroring usefully.
